item.title: Frito-Lay recalls Miss Vickie's chips over potentially 'life-threatening' allergen risk
item.description: Frito-Lay recalled Miss Vickie's Spicy Dill Pickle chips over an undeclared milk allergen. Certain bags may pose a serious risk to those with dairy allergies.

item.title: Ford wins over Democrats and Republicans as 'most American' brand in new survey
item.description: A major survey of 11,000 Americans reveals Ford as the "most American" brand, beating Coca-Cola, McDonald's and Apple across political and economic divides.

item.title: Samurai swords, WWII flight jacket, meteorite among items left behind by travelers: Unclaimed Baggage report
item.description: From gold-plated golf clubs to meteorites, a new report on traveler's unclaimed baggage from last year reveals the interesting items people are taking with them — and leaving behind.

item.title: Millions of jobs vulnerable as ‘silver tsunami’ looms over US small businesses, experts warn
item.description: Nearly half of U.S. small-business owners are 55 or older, and with many lacking succession plans, jobs and local economies could face disruptions in the coming decade, experts warn.

item.title: Ford builds one-of-a-kind Explorer for Pope Leo XIV
item.description: Ford CEO Jim Farley and wife Lia gifted Pope Leo XIV a customized Explorer SUV during a private Vatican audience on Feb. 28, featuring Chicago-themed details and a hybrid powertrain.

item.title: Philadelphia food stand overwhelmed when 600 tubs of onion dip mysteriously appear, prompting investigation
item.description: A Philadelphia food stand owner says she received 600 tubs of French onion dip she never ordered.

item.title: Southwest flight diverts to Atlanta airport, armed tactical units detain man in frightening security scare
item.description: Viral videos show armed officers removing passenger from Southwest flight in Atlanta as travelers describe 'scariest moments' during nine-hour ordeal.

item.title: Oracle expected to slash thousands of jobs as massive AI spending creates financial cash crisis
item.description: Oracle reportedly planning massive layoffs involving thousands of employees as AI spending creates cash crunch. Job cuts could reportedly affect 18% of total workforce.

item.title: Crude oil prices exceed $100 a barrel as war in Iran disrupts production, shipping
item.description: Oil prices surge past $100 per barrel for the first time in nearly four years as the Middle East conflict disrupts crucial shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Ford in deep water after sweeping recalls hit every model since 2020 — with one exception
item.description: Ford's aggressive recall strategy targets safety issues before major incidents. All models but one affected since 2020, including Bronco, Explorer, and F-150 Lightning.
